items.title: Agent Use Interface (AUI) – let users bring their own AI agent
items.raw_excerpt: As I started building AI integrations, I came to realize that for many projects, the the best agentic experience is one that simply enables the user's personal agent to take actions within your app. The existing options like MCP or A2A are quite involved and for simple apps that are already URL parameter driven, those options seem like overkill. This led me to prototype the Agent Use Interface (AUI) spec. The idea is simple: a lightweight, open spec that makes any app "agent-navigable." You drop an XML file at /agents/aui.xml that describes the URL-parameter-driven actions your app supports, like search, create, filter, etc. And that way any AI agent can read aui.xml, understand what's possible, and construct URLs on behalf of the user. items.title: Should we open our souls to AI? For better output?

items.title: An open-source AI Scrum Team that lives natively in GitHub Issues
items.raw_excerpt:
Hi HN,
I've been experimenting a lot with autonomous coding agents (like OpenClaw and various CLI tools), but I kept running into two major roadblocks when trying to use them for actual production work:
Security & State: Most agents require running a persistent state on a local machine or VPS, often needing broad file system access. It's a security nightmare for enterprise code.
Chaos: Generalist agents try to do everything at once (planning, coding, testing) in a single context window, which inevitably leads to hallucinations and broken dependencies.
I wanted a system that mirrored how actual engineering teams work, so I built an open-source framework that runs entirely inside GitHub.

items.title: 亚马逊正开发整合AI能力且与其语音助手Alexa同步的智能手机
items.raw_excerpt: 据媒体周五（3月20日）援引知情人士消息报道，亚马逊正在开发一款整合人工智能能力并能与公司语音助手Alexa同步的智能手机。该项目内部代号为“Transformer”，由亚马逊设备与服务部门负责研发，定位为一款高度个性化的移动设备。该手机的核心在于通过AI技术简化用户操作，可能无需传统应用商店即可使用功能，旨在让用户更便捷地使用亚马逊购物、Prime Video和Grubhub等服务。（新浪财经）

title_i18n.zh: 亚马逊正开发整合AI能力且与其语音助手Alexa同步的智能手机
title_i18n.en: Amazon is developing a smartphone that integrates AI capabilities and synchronizes with its voice assistant Alexa.
title_i18n.es: Amazon está desarrollando un teléfono inteligente que integra capacidades de IA y se sincroniza con su asistente de voz Alexa.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 据媒体周五（3月20日）援引知情人士消息报道，亚马逊正在开发一款整合人工智能能力并能与公司语音助手Alexa同步的智能手机。该项目内部代号为“Transformer”，由亚马逊设备与服务部门负责研发，定位为一款高度个性化的移动设备。该手机的核心在于通过AI技术简化用户操作，可能无需传统应用商店即可使用功能，旨在让用户更便捷地使用亚马逊购物、Prime Video和Grubhub等服务。（新浪财经）
excerpt_i18n.en: According to media reports on Friday (March 20) citing informed sources, Amazon is developing a smartphone that integrates artificial intelligence capabilities and can synchronize with its voice assistant Alexa. Internally codenamed "Transformer," the project is being developed by Amazon's Devices and Services division and is positioned as a highly personalized mobile device. The core of the phone lies in simplifying user operations through AI technology, potentially enabling functionality without the need for a traditional app store, aiming to make it easier for users to access services such as Amazon Shopping, Prime Video, and Grubhub. (Sina Finance)
excerpt_i18n.es: Según informaron medios el viernes (20 de marzo), citando fuentes informadas, Amazon está desarrollando un teléfono inteligente que integra capacidades de inteligencia artificial y puede sincronizarse con su asistente de voz Alexa. El proyecto, con nombre interno "Transformer", está siendo desarrollado por la división de Dispositivos y Servicios de Amazon y se posiciona como un dispositivo móvil altamente personalizado. El núcleo de este teléfono radica en simplificar las operaciones del usuario mediante tecnología de IA, posiblemente permitiendo el uso de funciones sin necesidad de una tienda de aplicaciones tradicional, con el objetivo de facilitar el acceso a servicios como las compras en Amazon, Prime Video y Grubhub. (Sina Finance)
